## Functions

### `createRealmLink({ linkId, realmId, branchId, localIdentity, signer, verifyIdentity, supportedCapabilities = [], authorizeCapabilities = async ({ requested, supported })`

Create one transport-independent logical link. `verifyIdentity` is required so cryptographic key ownership is also checked against Passport/device authorization rather than trusted from an embedded public key.

### `async attachRealmLinkTransport(link, session, { initiate = true } = {})`

Attach an existing transport session and optionally initiate the authenticated handshake.

### `async handleRealmLinkFrame(link, frame, { binding = null } = {})`

Verify, deduplicate, authorize, and dispatch one inbound Realm Link frame.

### `async sendRealmLinkData(link, kind, payload, { capability = null } = {})`

### `async upgradeRealmLinkTransport(link, candidateSession)`

Attempt a higher-priority channel while the current one remains live.
